description: List leases with unit, dates, lease type/status, current tenants, rent/deposit account details and eviction flag. Filter by property, owner, unit number, tenant name, dates, lease type or status (Active/Past/Future). Buildium: GET /v1/leases.

created_from.description: Created on or after — YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

created_to.description: Created on or before — YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

last_updated_from.description: Updated on or after — UTC, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

last_updated_to.description: Updated on or before — UTC, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

lease_date_from.description: Lease start date on or after — formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

lease_date_to.description: Lease end date on or before — formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

orderby.description: Sort, e.g. "Name", "LeaseToDate desc" or "Rent desc,City asc". Any field of the returned object.

rental_owner_ids.description: Filter to these rental owner ids.

tenant_name.description: A current tenant's name contains this value.

name: buildium_list_leases
title: List leases
